content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Synapticure: Care Team Intake Specialist USA Only All Other Remote Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7094/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote </p> <h3>About Synapticure</h3> <p>Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.</p> <p>Our business is powered by two connected engines.</p> <p><strong>The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)</strong></p> <p>A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.</p> <p><strong>The CURES Engine (Research &amp; Innovation)</strong></p> <p>Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.</p> <p>Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.</p><h4>About the Role</h4><ul><div> <p>Synapticure is dedicated to ensuring all individuals living with neurodegenerative diseases have equitable access to the highest standard of care while fueling the advancement of personalized treatments. We create a guided, compassionate journey for every patient, caregiver, and family, educating and empowering them while facilitating access to critical tests and leading specialists across the United States.</p> <p>As a Care Team Intake Specialist, you will be the welcoming first point of contact for members, caregivers, and loved ones navigating neurodegenerative conditions. You will drive essential clinical and administrative support functions, including scheduling, registration, referrals, and prior authorizations, serving as a trusted representative of Synapticure to our members, external healthcare organizations, and payer partners.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to make a meaningful, daily impact on people's lives within a mission-driven, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for an empathetic, curious, and organized communicator who thrives in collaborative spaces and is committed to delivering respectful, culturally responsive, and accessible care to diverse communities.</p> </div></ul><h4>The Day to Day</h4><ul><div> <p><strong>Member Engagement &amp; Care Coordination</strong></p> <li>Conduct welcoming, empathetic intake calls with new patients and caregivers to gather medical histories, current and past provider details, and insurance information.</li> <li>Schedule, confirm, and manage clinical appointments across virtual platforms, ensuring daily scheduling benchmarks and protocols are met.</li> <li>Proactively manage cancellations, rescheduling requests, and appointment reminders via phone, video, and digital communication tools.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the multidisciplinary care team to coordinate care, complete visit-related tasks, and execute FMLA forms.</li> <li>Advocate on behalf of patients and families with clinical providers, billing departments, and insurance partners while maintaining strict adherence to HIPAA guidelines.</li> <div><strong>Operations, Documentation &amp; Follow-Up</strong></div> <li>Request, collect, and audit external medical records, member consents, and HIPAA forms to ensure care teams have complete information prior to appointments.</li> <li>Conduct insurance eligibility checks and assist with prior authorizations and referral management.</li> <li>Accurately document member clinical and demographic data, calls, and correspondence in our Electronic Health Record (EHR) and care facilitation platforms in a timely manner.</li> <li>Manage incoming and outgoing communications, including faxes, digital messages, and mailed member resources.</li> <li>Follow standardized operating procedures and quality assurance protocols while remaining adaptable to evolving workflows and priorities.</li> <li>Generate standard operational reports and support additional care team initiatives as needed.</li> </div></ul><h4>Minimum Qualifications</h4><ul><div> <li>1-2+ years of experience in patient communication, care coordination, medical scheduling, or managing referrals and prior authorizations.</li> <li>Comfort with digital communication tools, telehealth platforms, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, and standard office technology.</li> <li>Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy guidelines and handling confidential medical records.</li> <li>Strong active listening skills and the ability to communicate clearly, patiently, and non-judgmentally with individuals from diverse backgrounds and varying accessibility needs.</li> <li>Ability to stay organized, prioritize tasks effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.</li> </div></ul><h4>Preferred Qualifications</h4><ul><div> <li>3+ years of experience in a healthcare setting, such as a Medical Assistant (MA), Patient Care Coordinator, Medical Records Specialist, or similar clinical/administrative support role.</li> <li>Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical terminology, FMLA documentation, and frequently prescribed medications.</li> <li>Experience requesting, reviewing, and auditing external medical records for completeness and accuracy.</li> <li>Hands-on proficiency with cloud-based EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks), macOS, and Google Workspace.</li> <li>Experience working in a remote setting, startup, or mission-driven organization undergoing rapid growth and change.</li> </div></ul><h4>Schedule</h4><ul><p>We are looking for candidates who are flexible to work the below schedule, based on your time zone, Monday through Friday.</p> <li>Pacific: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM PT</li> <li>Mountain: 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM MT</li> <li>Central: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM CT</li> <li>Eastern: 11:00 AM to 7:30 PM ET</li></ul><h3>Compensation</h3> <div>Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and
